title: Pan-Fried Broccolini, Lemon-Dressed
description: Broccolini charred in cast iron, then tossed in lemon zest, juice and olive oil.

items.item: Salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes
Pinch each salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes

steps.do: Prep. Cut away the dried ends. Any stalk thicker than a pencil gets halved lengthwise. Dry the broccolini well — water caught in the florets will steam it instead of browning it.
Season. Toss with 1 tsp oil, salt, pepper, and flakes. Go light; the dressing adds plenty more.
uses: Salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes

steps.do: Pan fry. Heat cast iron over medium-high until it just begins to smoke. Lay the broccolini in a single layer, cut side down. Leave it undisturbed 2–3 minutes, until the stalks have real color, then toss and cook 2 minutes more. A knife tip should slide into the stem with slight resistance, not none.
Zest the lemon, then juice half of it.
Dress. Take the pan off the heat. Whisk the dressing ingredients together in a bowl, add the broccolini, and toss to coat. Serve warm.
uses: Pinch each salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes

notes: Zest first, juice second — a whole lemon is far easier to grate.
Two batches beat one crowded pan. Crowded broccolini steams.
Dress it just before it goes to the table; it wilts if it sits in the lemon.

notes.group: If the pan just cooked steak
items: Pour off all but a thin film of fat and skip the oil in step 2.
Rest the pan off heat a minute, then cook over medium — post-sear cast iron will scorch the fond.
Keep golden fond; wipe out anything blackened.
Salt lightly. The rendered fat and leftover seasoning carry their own.
Whisk the steak's resting juices into the dressing.

source.name: a recipe supplied by the cook (source unattributed)
